title: Scope Dependabot Python requirements
summary: Scopes Python Dependabot updates to the repository's requirements directory and guards that contract.
reason: The Dependabot Dependency Graph run failed with "No supported dependency file present" while scanning the repo root for pip dependencies; the repo's supported Python requirements file is under requirements/dev.txt.
behavior_before: The pip Dependabot entry targeted /, which caused GitHub's dependency graph job to include an unsupported repo-root pip graph pass.
behavior_after: The pip Dependabot entry targets /requirements, matching requirements/dev.txt, and the audit-spine check verifies that scope.
rollback_plan: Change the pip Dependabot directory back to / and remove the /requirements assertion from check-github-audit-spine.ps1.
notes:
Scope Python Dependabot to requirements directory after dependency graph failed on repo root.
Guard Python Dependabot against unsupported repo-root scans.
